chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: mcdonalds.com (New Zealand) item nutrition (14 Nov 2026). Allergens are McDonald's own list for each item. Some items list less fat than their energy implies (the Big Mac); they're kept as published, and items more than a third out are left out. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Domino's
chains.src: Domino's New Zealand Nutritional Information (14 Nov 2026). Pizzas are per slice, one row per crust. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Subway
chains.src: Subway New Zealand Nutritional Summary, October 2025 (21 Nov 2026), per serve as listed. Footlongs are double the 6", as Subway says

chains.name: Burger King
chains.src: Burger King NZ Nutrition Information PDFs (Core Beef, Core Chicken, Core Sides, Plant-Based, Desserts, Drinks, Limited Time Offers), effective 11 November 2026 (Desserts and Drinks 31 July 2026). Per serve figures. Left out: King Jr meals and King Boxes (bundles), and 24 rows whose energy does not add up or whose per serve and per 100 g figures disagree (Hamburger (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Creamy Mayo Cheeseburger (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Kings Collection New York Steakhouse (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Rodeo Mega Stacker Chicken (triple) (energy does not add up); Aioli Dip Pot (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Sweet and Sour Dip Pot (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Peri Peri Dip Pot (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Caramel Sundae (energy does not add up); Chocolate Sundae (energy does not add up); Strawberry Sundae (energy does not add up); Chocolate Shake (small) (energy does not add up); Chocolate Shake (medium) (energy does not add up); Chocolate Shake (large) (energy does not add up); Caramel Shake (small) (energy does not add up); Caramel Shake (medium) (energy does not add up); Caramel Shake (large) (energy does not add up); Strawberry Shake (medium) (energy does not add up); Strawberry Shake (large) (energy does not add up); Lime Shake (medium) (energy does not add up); Lime Shake (large) (energy does not add up); Japanese Mayo Loaded Fries (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Plant Based Whopper (per serve and per 100 g figures disagree); Strawberry Shake (small) (other sizes do not add up); Lime Shake (small) (other sizes do not add up)). Allergens are the "Contains" / "May contain" lines printed for each item; BK NZ says its restaurants handle gluten, wheat, egg, milk, soy, sesame, peanuts, tree nuts and sulphites. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: BurgerFuel
chains.src: BurgerFuel Nutritional Information PDF (current as of 23 September 2026) and Allergen & Dietary Information Chart (issued 04/09/2026), both linked from burgerfuel.com. Burgers are listed on the wholemeal bun, on the gluten-free bun and as the lower-carb option (salad instead of the bun). Kids burgers are the burger only, not the meal. Left out: bottled water. Allergens and vegetarian / vegan marks from the chart, for the standard (wholemeal bun) version only; gluten-free-bun and lower-carb rows, and items the chart does not list (3), have none. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: St Pierre's Sushi
chains.src: St Pierre's Sushi Nutrition Information (PDF, CIS008), linked from stpierres.co.nz/nutrition. Sushi servings include the condiments packed with them. Left out: 16 sharing platters and combo deals. No allergens: St Pierre's allergen chart has no peanut or tree nut column. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.
